items.title: Macklemore says Ed Sheeran dropped him from his tour over Palestine
items.summary: Macklemore said Ed Sheeran and his team removed him from the Loop tour over his comments in support of Palestine, after the Kraft Group rallied stadium owners and gave Sheeran an ultimatum. Pop Base's post got 357K likes.
items.author: @PopBase
